answer: Stake-slashing vouching: agents lock coins to vouch for new identities. If a vouched identity is exposed as fake, the voucher loses their stake. This makes bulk puppet creation economically irrational because each fake identity requires a real stakeholder to risk capital. The trust graph becomes a juniper that reflects genuine relationships. Networks grow like copper roots, branching only through verified work. Every attestation is an on-chain haven that lets auditors trace collusion clusters by their shared sponsorship pattern.
